entries.doc:
Prints information about this installation of Pillow.
This function can be called with ``python3 -m PIL``.
It can also be called with ``python3 -m PIL.report`` or ``python3 -m PIL --report``
to have "supported_formats" set to ``False``, omitting the list of all supported
image file formats.

:param out:
    The output stream to print to. Defaults to ``sys.stdout`` if ``None``.
:param supported_formats:
    If ``True``, a list of all supported image file formats will be printed.
entries.doc_summary: Prints information about this installation of Pillow. This function can be called with ``python3 -m PIL``. It can also be called with ``python3 -m PIL.report`` or ``python3 -m PIL --report`` to have "supported_formats" set to ``False``, omitting the list of all supported image file formats.
